18764386.reason: Chooses the element nearest to the mean as target rather than the median; on 0003 the nearest-to-mean element 7 costs 108 instead of the optimal 104.

3746791.reason: Brute-forces every target 0..10000 summing |a_i - j| over all n*m cells: O(n*m*10^4) up to 1e8 Python ops; on 0016 (53x91) it needs ~4.8e7 ops and ran 2.7s CPU in my sandbox vs 2s limit (max tests 100x100 also time out).

4039763.reason: Targets the residue-class value nearest the arithmetic mean instead of the median; L1 cost is minimized at the median. On 0003 (5 7 1 2 5 100, d=1) mean ~20 gives 160, median gives 104.

4803409.reason: Uses rounded mean of a_i//d as target instead of the median, which does not minimize the sum of absolute deviations; 0003 gives 160 instead of 104.

7253300.reason: Feasibility check compares only a[0][0] % d with the maximum residue over all cells, so mixed residues pass whenever the first cell has the max residue (and it floors non-multiple distances); 0002 (6 7, d=7: residues 6 and 0) prints 0 instead of -1.
